# PiTTy 0.6.52

## Model picker now shows timing and speed

- The Ctrl+P / settings model picker now reads request timing and TTFT/speed stats reactively from the active runtime, so freshly recorded samples appear without reopening PiTTy. Previously the picker captured a stale snapshot and showed no timing even though the sidebar did.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.52` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
